profile.headline: Software Engineer | JavaScript | CSS | React | Python | SQL | Django | AWS | CI/CD Pipelines | Shopify Customization | Railway | DigitalOcean
profile.summary: My name is Melissa Carter. I am a graduate of Nashville Software School and have worked at HCA since 2008.I take great pride in my journey as a software engineer and am motivated by the opportunity to create impactful solutions. I love helping people and creating new things.  I am constantly learning more skills so that I can "do more"!In my free time, I enjoy designing, crafting, spending time with my family, and enjoying time with my animals.  My business website is 1rockstarsocial.com

positions.title: Legal Assistant
positions.description:
Provide secretarial and legal assistance for four corporate attorneys
⋅ Type and process legal documents and contracts per the legal department protocol
⋅ Assist in reviewing and management of legal agreements
⋅ Manage calendars, book travel reservations, and complete expense reports
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Office · Project Management · Microsoft Outlook · Adobe Professional · Attention to Detail

positions.title: Software Developer Apprentice
positions.description:
Intensive part-time software development boot camp focusing on full stack development fundamentals and problem solving. The final half of the program are executed in a simulated company environment with Scrum methodology.

Daily hands on application of OOP fundamentals through group and individual projects
Created single page applications in JavaScript, as well as in the React framework
Project management/tracking with GitHub project boards and issue tracking
Source code/version control with Git/GitHub
Solution Design: white-boarding and wireframes
Leveraged Django for creating and editing server-generated web applications
Created RESTful API’s with Django REST framework
Retrieved and stored database information with SQLite 
Practiced testing with Python’s unit test framework
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · GitHub · Django REST Framework · JavaScript · React.js · Visual Studio · SQL
